config.message: Hello! Thank you for calling XYZ company.

config.prompt: The caller said they need {{ userNeed }} classify their intent.

config.knowledgeBase:
XYZ Company is a licensed home services company serving the greater Colombo area and surrounding regions.

SERVICES: We provide plumbing (leak repairs, pipe installations, drain unblocking, water heater installation), electrical (wiring, fault finding, switchboard upgrades, lighting installation, safety inspections), and HVAC (air conditioning installation and servicing, heating systems, ventilation, duct cleaning).

HOURS: We are open Monday to Friday 8am to 6pm and Saturday 9am to 1pm. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays.

EMERGENCY: We offer a 24/7 emergency call-out service for urgent plumbing and electrical issues. Emergency rates apply outside of normal business hours.

PRICING: We provide free no-obligation quotes for all jobs. Standard call-out fee is 1500 LKR which is waived if you proceed with the work. Hourly labour rates start from 3500 LKR. We provide upfront fixed pricing for common jobs.

BOOKING: You can book an appointment through this line and our agent will confirm a time. We typically have availability within 1 to 3 business days. Same-day appointments may be available depending on technician availability.

SERVICE AREA: We service Colombo, Negombo, Gampaha, Kalutara, Kandy, and surrounding districts. Travel surcharges may apply for locations beyond 50km from Colombo.

GUARANTEE: All our work comes with a 90-day workmanship guarantee. Parts and materials carry the manufacturer warranty.

LICENSING: All our technicians are fully licensed, insured, and background checked.

CONTACT: Main line 555-0100. Email info@xyzcompany.lk. For emergencies call 555-0199.

FAQ: Do you do same-day bookings? Yes, subject to availability, call us early. Are your prices negotiable? We offer fixed upfront pricing but can discuss for larger jobs. Do you provide a written quote? Yes, always before starting work. Can I pay by card? Yes, we accept cash, card, and bank transfer.
